chase: Warmer already. Good, that means you're close to me.
Run all you like, I'm only getting hotter as I go.
Keep moving. The faster you run, the faster I catch up.
Don't bother locking that door. I'm coming straight through it.
Stop running in circles. I can see you turning every time.
Left, then right, then straight into my warmth.
Every step you take warms this hallway up a little more.
You can't outrun the heat. Nobody ever has.
I'm right behind you, and I'm getting impatient.
Come on, faster. I haven't got all day, runner.
Stop hiding around corners. I can feel exactly where you are.
Around the bend and straight at you, no slowing down.
Don't look back. I'm closer than I was a minute ago.
Keep running. I'll be right over your shoulder soon.
Warm, warmer, hot. You're getting closer to me.
Fast feet, runner. Fast feet make a far better chase.
Getting warmer, closer, and closer again.
You're burning up the hall, aren't you?
Sprint if you like. Every step brings me closer.
catch: Caught you. Stop wriggling, you'll only make it hotter.
Got you. Gently, mostly. Sit down and cool off.
Found you, and you're coming with me. Quick march.
Caught. Don't kick, it only makes me sweat.
Right, you're mine now. Let's get you out of the draft.
There we go. Nice and close, where I can see you.
You're not getting away from me this time.
Oof, you're heavy. Stop squirming and walk properly.
Caught, and I'm not even out of breath. Barely.
Dragging you back to the lounge. Don't make it difficult.
Lovely, one more for the lounge. Don't fight it.
Got one. Tell the others I'm the one who caught them.
Got one of yours. The rest of you, keep moving.
Another one caught. Keep your eyes open, the rest of you.
Right, you're mine. Stop trying to run now.
Caught you. Cool down, I'm holding you now.
Got you. You're warm, so I'll go gentle.
Stop there. You're too warm to get away.
hear: Heard that. Somebody is making a racket by the stairs.
Was that a door? Someone is being very loud.
Ooh, a shout. Let's go and see who it is.
Something broke over there. Naturally, I'm going to look.
Quick footsteps upstairs. I'm already on my way.
I can hear you breathing from here. Relax, I'm coming.
Something smashed in the north wing. Right, let's go.
That noise was loud enough to wake the whole house.
Somebody is stomping around up there. Say hello for me.
Heard you. Stop making that noise and I'll go easy.
Another crash. Honestly, can nobody here be quiet?
Louder than a lamp, that one. Off I go.
A door creaked behind me. Turning around to look now.
Shouting in the hall. Lovely, I'll go warm it up.
Scuffling by the vents. That's where you're hiding, isn't it.
Whatever that was came from the lounge. Going now.
Something sizzled by the stove. Let me check.
A door rattled up ahead. Warmer over there.
Heard a crash, and it's hot in that room.
search: Where did you go? Don't make me search every room.
Lost you for a moment. That won't happen again.
Gone quiet. Fine. I'll sniff around until you show up.
No trail left, which is annoying. Checking the cupboards.
Searching the hallway, room by room. You can't hide forever.
The warmth went cold out there. Back to looking.
Lost your heat trail. Right, sweeping the next wing.
Gone again. I'll walk the halls until I feel you.
Nobody there. Typical. Back to the lounge to think.
Lost you. I'll go back on patrol and listen out.
I'll check the lounge again, then the stairs.
You're hiding somewhere. I'm going to find it.
Quiet now. Too quiet. I don't like it at all.
Fine, I'll search properly. I was going to anyway.
Patience is not my strong point, but I'll try.
Still no sign. Going back to patrol for now.
stunned: Ow. Fine. That's a good one, I'll admit it.
Stop it. That stung more than you'd think.
Give me a second. My head's still ringing.
Shaking it off. Don't stand there looking pleased.
A zap? Cute. It'll take more than that.
Crowbar, really? Right, that was a mistake.
That axe hurt. I'm going to remember it.
Held still, and I hate it. Let me go.
I'm up now. Give me a moment to feel my hands.
Recovering. Don't you dare run while I'm slow.
My arms won't behave. Give me a second, runner.
Well, that stung. Right, back on my feet.
Dizzy now, but you won't get away that easily.
That was rude. I'm going to be extremely cross about it.
Recovering. Quick, somebody get me a cold drink.
Heat's back in my hands. Now we're even, runner.
hide_spot: Locker? Cute. It's getting warm in there.
Under the bed, is it? I can feel that from here.
Hiding in the bed again. Let's see how warm you get.
Checking the locker. Come out before I open it.
Right behind the cupboard door. I can see your shoes.
Every hiding spot in this house heats up eventually.
Locker's shut, but I can hear you breathing inside.
Tucked under the covers? Warm bed, poor choice.
Hiding in the wardrobe. You're not very subtle.
Walking past the locker, and this time I'm stopping.
One more hiding spot checked. Warm, but empty.
Empty bed. Still warm, though. You were just here.
Hiding places are for people who don't like the heat.
Open the locker. Hot in here, isn't it? Oh, there you are.
Under the desk now? Desks don't hide anybody from me.
Bed's still warm. Nobody move, I'm coming to look.
light: Turn that flashlight off, it's far too bright.
Ah, the beam. Lovely, very warm, very rude.
Do you mind? That's right in my eyes.
Bright light, like the sun. I don't mind it much.
Sunshine in my face. Thanks, that's exactly what I needed.
Put the light down before you make me angry.
Dazzled, which is rude, but I'm used to it.
Squinting now. You'll pay for that, runner.
Lamp on my face again. The lounge fire is brighter.
Blinding me is not a plan. Keep it coming, though.
Oh, the light. I'd make a joke, but I'm squinting.
Flashlight right in my eyes. Tiresome, honestly.
Stop waving it about. You're making me dizzy.
Blinking away the glare. Keep it up and I'll get cross.
Bright beam, bright idea. Well done, you've annoyed me.
Shine that somewhere else, I'm already warm enough.
idle: I keep the lounge fire going. Somebody has to, honestly.
Anyone cold in the lounge comes straight to me.
Who's cold? Come sit by me and I'll sort you out.
Nothing beats sitting by the fire with my jacket open.
A warm room is a happy room. That's all I'm saying.
Mornings in the lounge start with my fire. Always.
The lounge crackles when everyone squeezes in close. Lovely.
I like the fire best when someone is shivering next to it.
Keep the heat up, you lot. I'm coming to help.
Who's been sitting in my warm spot? Move, I need it.
Patrol is slow work. Give me something to do.
Sunshine indoors. Some hunters think that's silly. They're wrong.
Nothing happening, so I'll sit down and warm up.
Quiet shift. I'd rather be hot and busy, thanks.
Somebody make me a cup of tea. Strong, please.
Keep your fists warm, you lot. We may be needed.
ability: Every half minute I burn one battery nobody collected.
Uncollected batteries are my favorite. I burn them down.
Leave a battery on the floor and I'll warm it empty.
A battery left lying about is one I've already burned.
The hotter it gets, the faster my fists move.
My sun glyph glows orange when the house is cooking.
The sun on my head glows brighter as the room warms.
Reach the top of the heat and I never leave again.
Heat's at the top now. Nothing is going to cool me down.
Once I'm awake, I stay awake. That's the deal.
One battery gone, just like that. Heat does that.
Good, you've collected them. Now I'll burn the rest.
Hurry up and collect them, or I'll burn them first.
The heat is up through the whole house. I'm awake for good.
Every battery in this house is on my list now.
Cool the hall if you want me to slow down. Good luck.
mechanic: Relay panel ahead. Hurry up and fix it, I'm waiting.
Vent cover's loose. You'd crawl through that, wouldn't you?
Crawling through the vents? I'll wait at the far end.
Door's locked? Then I'll heat the handle until it gives.
Radar's pinging again. Someone is close by.
Stairs are slippery when everything is this hot.
Mind the stairs. I'm taking them two at a time.
Batteries on the shelf. Take them now, before I burn them.
Items on the table. Grab what you need, I'm coming.
That fall would have hurt. Watch your feet on the ledge.
Sabotage the heater and I'll find out who did it.
Heater's broken. Somebody is going to fix that right now.
Fuse box is sparking. Leave it alone, you'll get hurt.
Doors all open. Good, that saves me the trouble.
Relay's lit up. Take it, the heat is climbing again.
Heat's rising in the lounge. Find the next relay quickly.
The heater relay is behind the stove. Fix it.
Batteries heat up in the sun. Keep yours cool.
Vent is hot to the touch. Use the other one.
